linkedin_featured_post.author: Meenu Balaji
linkedin_featured_post.award: Best Nutritionist 2026 by Realistic Awards, Pakwan Chennai
linkedin_featured_post.content: Returning to Chennai after 21 years felt like stepping into familiar streets with an unfamiliar future. There was excitement, but also genuine apprehension about whether my work, values, and practice would find their place again. What followed reaffirmed everything I believe in. The warmth, trust, and generosity of the people of Chennai have been deeply humbling. I’m incredibly honoured to be recognised as Best Nutritionist 2026 by the Realistic Awards, Pakwan Chennai. I’m deeply grateful to every client who placed their trust in me and my work. Here’s to transforming more people and their lives for the better.

youtube_channel.title: Pragmatic Nutrition
youtube_channel.description:
Evidence-based nutrition for gut health, child nutrition, ADHD support, hormonal balance, and sports performance.

I’m Meenu Balaji, founder of Pragmatic Nutrition, with 14+ years of experience working with children, women, and athletes across India, the UK, and New Zealand. This channel breaks down nutrition without trends or hype, only practical, research-backed guidance that fits real life.

You’ll find short, clear videos on gut health, ADHD in children, sleep and focus, Indian diets, metabolic health, and performance nutrition for young athletes. We also unpack how modern lifestyle factors like food quality, screen time, and sleep impact long-term health.

If you want credible nutrition advice that prioritises clarity, outcomes, and sustainability, you’re in the right place.
